build_task_with_define_task: use the define_task decorator to register a build_task function that creates a PHYRE task
create_dynamic_boxes_with_add_box: call C.add_box with width, height, and dynamic=True to create movable box bodies in the scene
position_bodies_with_set_bottom_set_left: chain set_bottom and set_left on a body to position it within the PHYRE scene
assign_spatial_relationship_with_update_: call C.update_task with body1, body2, and SpatialRelationship.TOUCHING to define the task goal
access_scene_dimensions: read C.scene.width and C.scene.height to get scene dimensions for calculating object sizes
